english.title: Fail to comply with direction for return/disposal of document/article acquired through unauthorised disclosure etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having had in your possession or under your control

(A)_[a document,]_
(B)_[an article,]_

for which it would be an offence under section 5 of the Official Secrets Act 1989 for you to disclose, failed to comply with an official direction for its

(C)_[return]_
(D)_[disposal]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(4)(a) and 10(2) of the Official Secrets Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
had in his/her possession or under his/her control any document / article
which it would be an offence under s5 of the Act for him/her to disclose without lawful authority
he failed to comply with an official direction for its return or disposal

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
